The problem

You shipped code you didn’t fully write, and nobody has really reviewed it.

What it does

VibeCaddie reviews your repository and tells you what to fix first.

How it works

  1. Works out what kind of codebase it is and checks only what applies
  2. Every finding comes with the file, the line, why it matters and a fix
  3. Double-checks each finding before showing it, so you get fewer false alarms

Pay per run with prepaid credits, so you know the price before it starts. Early access is open.

Built to turn days of waiting for a review into minutes.

TodayBeing built. The site and early-access list are open; the GitHub app is not out yet.

Aims

Autonomous operation
The product is an agent and the company should be too: install, audit, findings, credits, support and skill updates all run without a person in the loop. People review the review skills and set the prices.
Intelligence
Reasoning over code: repository classification, skill selection, severity ranking and fix suggestions, with a verification pass so a finding is confirmed before it is shown. Judged on precision, not volume.
Growth
Usage-led. Growth is repositories audited and credits bought again, counted from the first run of the GitHub app.
The technical detail

A code review agent for the code you did not fully write. It reads a repository, works out what kind of codebase it is, loads only the review skills that apply to it, and returns findings ranked by severity with the file, the line, why it matters and a suggested fix. Prepaid credits rather than a subscription, so the price of a run is known before it starts. The site and the early-access list are open; the GitHub app is not built.
